calibration_sources: Megatron-Core / PyTorch Selective Activation Checkpointing (SAC: Policy-Driven Op-Level Rematerialization)
TorchTitan / DeepSpeed Zero-SM Copy-Engine Async Activation Offload to Host Pinned DRAM
Transformer Activation Memory Roofline (34*b*s*h Bytes/Layer vs 2*b*s*h Layer-Boundary Checkpointing)

workload_baseline.cluster: 128x H100 80GB SXM5 ($320/hr), 70B LLM (80 layers, TP=8, CP=2, FSDP2)

tiers.name: Tier 1: No Activation Checkpointing (Store All Intermediate Layer Tensors in HBM -> Immediate OOM)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 1: 不开激活重计算 (全量保存每层中间张量：仅激活值即狂吞 118.4GB 直接爆显存 OOM)
tiers.mechanism: Retains all QKV, Attention, O-Proj, Gate/Up/SwiGLU/Down & RMSNorm intermediate tensors across 80 layers

tiers.name: Tier 2: Full Layer-Boundary Activation Checkpointing (Save Only Layer Input, Recompute Entire Block -> +33.3% FLOP Tax)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 2: 全量层边界重计算 (Full Checkpointing：显存压至 14.2GB，但重算整层矩阵乘白烧 +33.3% 算力)
tiers.mechanism: Discards all intra-layer tensors and re-runs the entire Transformer layer (including heavy QKV/FFN GEMMs) during backward

tiers.name: Tier 3: Selective Operator Checkpointing (SAC: Recompute Only FlashAttn + SwiGLU + Norm, Keep Heavy Linear GEMMs)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 3: 算子级选择性重计算 (Selective Op Checkpointing：只重算廉价非线性算子，保留昂贵 GEMM 输出)
tiers.mechanism: PyTorch SAC policy saves QKV/O/FFN GEMM outputs (high FLOPs, moderate bytes) and recomputes only FlashAttn, SwiGLU, RoPE & RMSNorm

tiers.name: Tier 4: Selective Op Checkpointing + Zero-SM Async PCIe Gen5 Pinned DRAM Activation Offload (1-Layer Pipelined Prefetch)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 4: 算子级选择性重算 + 零 SM 异步 PCIe Gen5 主机内存激活卸载与单层流水线预取
tiers.mechanism: Combines SAC (+2.8% FLOPs) with Copy-Engine async D2H offload of retained GEMM activations to Host Pinned DRAM & 1-layer backward H2D prefetch

seq_scaling_perturbation.verdict: Both Tier 3 (SAC) and Tier 4 fit easily in 80GB HBM; avoids Tier 2's +33.3% GEMM recompute tax
Tier 4 frees +24.4 GB/GPU of HBM headroom over Tier 3 while running 1.31x faster than Tier 2
Pure SAC (Tier 3) OOMs at 98.0 GB (>80GB)! Tier 4 async PCIe offload keeps HBM at 49.2 GB with 55.9% MFU
Tier 4 is the only scheme that fits 128K in 80GB HBM without paying the +33.3% full-recompute penalty
